table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	icode=dbo.item.icode , 
	aliasname=dbo.item.customicode, 
	currqty=Case When sum(GD.currqty) IS NULL Then 0 Else sum(GD.currqty) End, 
	minqty=dbo.item.minqty,  
	optimumqty=0,
	reorderqty=0, 
	rate=dbo.item.purprice,
	packunits=dbo.item.packunits,
	item=dbo.item.name,  
	Manufacturer=dbo.Manufacturer.name,
	ItemCategory=dbo.ItemCategory.name,
	ItemClass=dbo.ItemClass.name,
	ItemPacking=(SELECT IP.Name FROM ItemPacking IP WHERE IP.Packcode = dbo.item.packcode),
	genericitem=(SELECT genericitem.name FROM genericitem WHERE genericitem.genericCode = dbo.item.genericCode),
	SaleOrderCode=S.SaleOrderCode,
	LooseQty=S.LooseQty,
	BonusQty=S.BonusQty,
	PurchaseOrdered=ISNULL((SELECT qty=sum(D.Qty * D.PackUnits) 
									FROM PurOrderDetail D, PurOrderHeader H 
									WHERE H.SaleOrderCode=:ai_saleordercode AND 
												H.POCode = D.POcode AND 
												D.Icode = dbo.item.icode), 0),
	TransitStock = ISNULL(dbo.item.transitstock, 0),
	MinQty = ISNULL(dbo.item.MinQty, 0),
	LastPurInvCode = CASE WHEN dbo.Fn_GetPreference('fetchlastpurinfoinpo')='Y' THEN (SELECT MAX(P.PurInvCode) FROM PurDetail D, PurLedger P WHERE D.ICode = Item.ICode AND P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND P.Posted='Y') ELSE 0 END,
	LastPurDate = CASE WHEN dbo.Fn_GetPreference('fetchlastpurinfoinpo')='Y' THEN (SELECT MAX(P.Date) FROM PurDetail D, PurLedger P WHERE D.ICode = Item.ICode AND P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND P.Posted='Y') ELSE 0 END,
	gstperc=dbo.item.gstperc1,
	packsalestax=dbo.item.packsalestax,
	purprice=dbo.item.purprice,
	saleprice=dbo.item.saleprice,
	rpp=dbo.item.recentpurprice,
	packavgprice=ROUND(dbo.item.avgprice * dbo.item.packunits, 2)

FROM 
	dbo.item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT GDD.* FROM dbo.godowndetail GDD WHERE GDD.GCode IN (SELECT G.GCode FROM Godown G WHERE G.ConsiderStockINPO='Y')) AS GD ON (dbo.item.icode = GD.icode),
	dbo.Manufacturer,
	dbo.itemcategory,
	dbo.itemclass,
	(SELECT SaleOrderCode, ICode, Looseqty=Sum(LooseQty), Bonusqty=Sum(BonusQty)
	FROM SaleOrderDetail 
	WHERE SaleOrderCode = :ai_saleordercode
	GROUP BY SaleOrderCode, ICode) S

WHERE
	( 
		dbo.item.manfcode in (:ar_manfcode) OR 
		dbo.item.icatcode in (:ar_icatcode) OR 
	 	dbo.item.iccode in (:ar_iccode) OR 
		dbo.item.Packcode in (:ar_Packcode) OR
		dbo.item.NAME LIKE (:ar_itemlike)
	) AND 
	( dbo.item.icode = S.ICode ) AND 
	( dbo.item.manfcode = dbo.manufacturer.manfcode ) AND
	( dbo.Item.ICatCode = dbo.itemcategory.icatcode ) AND
	( dbo.Item.ICCode = dbo.itemclass.iccode ) AND
	( dbo.Item.Active = 1 ) 
GROUP BY 
	S.SaleOrderCode,
	dbo.item.icode , 
	dbo.item.manfcode, 
	dbo.item.purprice,
	dbo.item.saleprice,
	dbo.item.recentpurprice,
	dbo.item.avgprice,
 	dbo.item.packunits,
	dbo.item.name,
	dbo.Manufacturer.Name,
	dbo.ItemCategory.name,
	dbo.ItemClass.name,
	dbo.Item.PackCode,
	dbo.item.genericcode,
	dbo.item.customicode,
	dbo.item.transitstock,
	dbo.item.MinQty,
	S.LooseQty,
	S.BonusQty,
	dbo.item.gstperc1,
	dbo.item.packsalestax
ORDER BY manufacturer, item
